Source Text:

Source Text:
Aid Attack

A creature who uses the Aid Attack maneuver chooses an enemy adjacent to them. The next ability roll an ally makes against that enemy before the start of the aiding creature’s next turn gains an edge.

Target Text:
喘息

瀕死的生物（詳見下文「體力」中的「Dying and Death」）無法使用喘息機動動作，但其他生物可以用其他方式協助他們花費復元力。
Source Text:
Catch Breath

A creature who uses the Catch Breath maneuver spends a Recovery and regains Stamina equal to their recovery value. (See below for Stamina. See Recoveries in Chapter 1: The Basics.)

Target Text:
衝鋒

當你執行衝鋒主要動作時，你會以直線方式移動最多等於自身速度的距離（期間不能跳躍），然後在移動結束時對 1 個目標發動 1 次近戰基礎打擊（詳見下文「基礎打擊」）。若你擁有帶有「衝鋒」關鍵詞的招式，你也可以發動該招式來取代基礎打擊。

你在衝鋒期間無法穿越困難地形或進行遁移。若你擁有相應的移動能力，你可以在衝鋒期間飛行或掘地，但在衝鋒期間無法攀爬或游泳，除非你能夠自動以全速進行這類移動。
Source Text:
Charge

When a creature takes the Charge main action, they move up to their speed in a straight line without jumping, then make a melee free strike (see Free Strikes below) against a target when they end their move. If the creature has an ability with the Charge keyword, they can use that ability against the target instead of a free strike.

A creature can’t move through difficult terrain or shift when they charge. They can fly or burrow as part of the Charge main action if they have that movement available to them, but they can’t climb or swim while charging unless they can automatically use that movement at full speed.

Target Text:
防禦

若你執行防禦主要動作，針對你進行的所有招式檢定都會承受雙劣勢，直到你下個回合開始。此外，若你被要求進行考驗來抵抗環境效果、生物的特性或招式，你的考驗會獲得雙優勢。若有其他生物正被你嘲諷，你無法從此動作中獲得任何好處（詳見第 5 章〈職業〉的「狀態」）。
Source Text:
Defend

When a creature takes the Defend main action, ability rolls made against them have a double bane until the start of their next turn. Additionally, you have a double edge on tests when called for to resist environmental effects or a creature’s traits or abilities. A creature gains no benefit from this action while another creature is taunted by them (see Conditions in Chapter 5: Classes).

Target Text:
撤離

若你執行撤離移動動作，你可以遁移 1 格。某些職業特性、套裝和其他機制會允許你在撤離時遁移超過 1 格。若是如此，你可以隨意將這段遁移拆分到在其他機動動作和主要動作之間。
Source Text:
Disengage

When a creature takes the Disengage move action, they can shift 1 square. Certain class features, kits, and other rules allow a creature to shift more than 1 square when they disengage. A creature who does so can break up their shift with their maneuver and main action however they wish.

Target Text:
免費機動動作

例如開啟未上鎖的門、從地上撿起箭矢、將物體交給相鄰的盟友，或是拔出武器等瑣碎行為，都不需要使用機動動作或主要動作。你可以在自己的回合中執行這些簡單的免費機動動作。免費機動動作雖然遵循一般機動動作的規則，但通常不限次數。

根據導演的判斷，某些情況可能會讓原本簡單的行為變得更有挑戰性和戲劇性。例如，若你試圖在劇烈地震時撿起地上的魔法箭矢，這個原本可以用免費機動動作完成的動作，可能就需要使用 1 個機動動作或主要動作才能完成。

同樣地，某些行為會因為太過複雜而無法以免費機動動作完成。例如，抱起失去意識的異能者盟友並帶到安全處，大概可以用免費機動動作完成。但如果你的力量不足，而你需要抱起 1 名穿著【Shining Armor】套裝的戰術家盟友，導演可能會判定你需要使用一般機動動作，才能把穿著護甲的他扛到肩上。

任何會禁止你使用機動動作的效果，同樣也會禁止你使用免費機動動作。
Source Text:
Free Maneuvers

Boring stuff like opening an unlocked door, picking up an arrow from the ground, giving an object to an adjacent ally, or drawing a weapon doesn’t require a maneuver or a main action. Rather, you can undertake such straightforward activities as free maneuvers on your turn. A free maneuver follows the same rules as a regular maneuver, but you can typically take as many free maneuvers as you like.

At the Director’s discretion, circumstances could make something that is typically boring more impactful and exciting. For instance, if you need to pick a magic arrow up off the ground during a violent earthquake, what would otherwise be a free maneuver could require a maneuver or a main action to accomplish.

Likewise, the nature of an activity might make it too complicated for a free maneuver. For example, picking up the body of an unconscious talent ally to carry them to safety can probably be done as a free maneuver. But if your Might is lacking and you need to pick up a tactician ally decked out in the Shining Armor kit, the Director might determine that you need to use a regular maneuver to hoist their armored form over your shoulders.

Any effect that prevents you from using maneuvers also prevents you from using free maneuvers.

Target Text:
基礎打擊

你可以使用此主要動作來發動 1 次基礎打擊（詳見下文「基礎打擊」）。大多數時候，最好的選擇是使用由職業、套裝或其他特性賦予、效果更強的主要動作，就像導演通常會使用生物數據欄中的主要動作一樣。不過，當其他手段都派不上用場時，基礎打擊永遠可用。例如，熾怒者若沒有其他遠程打擊選項，在對抗飛行敵人時，可能會使用臨時武器發動【遠程武器基礎打擊】招式。
Source Text:
Free Strike

A creature can use this main action to make a free strike (see Free Strikes below). Most of the time, you’ll want to use the more impactful main actions granted by your class, kit, or other feature, just as the Director will use the main actions in a creature’s stat block, but free strikes are available for when all else fails. For instance, a fury who has no other options for ranged strikes might use the Ranged Weapon Free Strike ability with an improvised weapon when battling a flying foe.

Target Text:
擒抱

若你想將敵人控制在近身距離並限制他的行動，可以使用以下招式來嘗試擒制目標。

擒抱

Heal

躲藏

若你具有掩護或遮蔽，你可以使用躲藏機動動作，嘗試躲避沒有觀察到你的其他生物。完整規則請見第 9 章〈考驗〉的「躲藏與潛行」。
Source Text:
Hide

Using the Hide maneuver, a creature attempts to hide from other creatures who aren’t observing them while they have cover or concealment. See Hide and Sneak in Chapter 9: Tests for full details.

Target Text:
主要動作

當你執行主要動作時，最常見的用途是發動由職業、套裝或寶物賦予的特殊招式（詳見第 5 章〈職業〉的「招式」）。這些招式可以讓你執行最獨特、最具特色且最有影響力的動作。

你也可以使用主要動作來幫助其他生物恢復體力、衝鋒陷陣、保護自己，或發動基礎打擊。

你可以將主要動作轉換成機動動作或移動動作，讓你在自己的回合中使用 2 個機動動作或 2 個移動動作。
Source Text:
Main Actions

When you take a main action, you most often do so to use a unique ability granted by your class, kit, or a treasure (see Abilities in Chapter 5: Classes). These abilities represent the most unique, flavorful, and impactful things you can do with your main action.

You can also use your main action to help another creature regain Stamina, charge into battle, defend yourself, or make a free strike.

You can convert your main action into a maneuver or a move action, allowing you to take two maneuvers or move actions on your turn.

Target Text:
進行或協助考驗

在戰鬥中，許多考驗都屬於機動動作。例如用理智考驗來搜索寶箱、用敏捷考驗來打開門鎖，或用力量考驗來抬起閘門等，都算是機動動作。在戰鬥中協助他人進行考驗同樣也是機動動作（詳見第 9 章〈考驗〉的「協助考驗（Assist a Test）」）。

在戰鬥中，較複雜或耗時的考驗可能需要使用主要動作來執行，甚至可能耗時太久而根本無法在戰鬥中完成。另一方面，幾乎不花時間的考驗通常屬於免費機動動作（例如用理智考驗來回想木乃伊的相關知識）。哪些考驗可以作為機動動作進行，最終由導演決定。
Source Text:
Make or Assist a Test

Many tests are maneuvers if made in combat. Searching a chest with a Reason test, picking a door’s lock with an Agility test, or lifting a portcullis with a Might test would all be maneuvers. Assisting a test is also a maneuver in combat (see Assist a Test in Chapter 9: Tests).

Complex or time-consuming tests might require a main action if made in combat—or could take so long that they can’t be made during combat at all. Other tests that take no time at all, such as a Reason test to recall lore about mummies, are usually free maneuvers in combat. The Director has the final say regarding which tests can be made as maneuvers.

Target Text:
機動動作

機動動作需要的專注力和體能消耗比主要動作更少（詳見下文）。你可以使用機動動作來移動其他生物、飲用藥水或進行類似的行為。

有時候，你可能沒有適合的機動動作可以執行，這完全沒問題！很多時候，你的回合只要進行主要動作就夠了。
Source Text:
Maneuvers

A maneuver typically involves less focus and exertion than a main action (see below). It can be an opportunity to move other creatures, drink a potion, or undertake similar activities.

Sometimes you might not have anything you can do with your maneuver. That’s totally fine! Often, the best thing to do on your turn is take a main action and move on.

Target Text:
移動動作

移動動作可以讓你在戰場上移動。有時候，你可能已經處於理想位置，不需要在回合中使用移動動作，這完全沒問題！選擇停留或移動都是同樣重要的戰術決定。
Source Text:
Move Actions

A move action allows a creature to move around the battlefield. Sometimes you’ll already be exactly where you want to be so that you don’t need to use a move action on your turn. That’s okay! The decision to not move is just as tactical as the decision to move.

Target Text:
移動

在戰鬥中，生物可以透過許多機制在戰場上移動，其中最常見的是行進與撤離移動動作（詳見下文「移動動作」）。此外，你的職業、裝備、族裔、稱號或其他選項所賦予的招式，也可能提供額外的移動方式。

英雄的族裔會決定起始移動速度，通常是 5。這代表當你執行行進移動動作或其他效果允許你移動時，你最多可以移動的格數。速度可以透過套裝和其他遊戲選項來提升。

若想移動到相鄰的任何方格，包括斜向方格，都只需要花費 1 格移動力。沒錯，方格地圖上不需要套用畢氏定理。這是遊戲，別想太多。

你的英雄可以自由穿過盟友的空間。你也可以穿過敵人的空間，但這些空間會視為困難地形（詳見下文）。除非該生物的體型與你相差至少 2 階，否則你不能在該生物的空間停下來，也不能在該空間內發動打擊、使用主要動作或機動動作後再繼續移動。

在導演裁定下，你可能會被迫和體型與你相差不超過 1 階的生物共占 1 格，例如掉進有其他生物占據的狹窄豎井。在這種情況下，你的招式檢定與考驗都會承受 1 個劣勢。
Source Text:
Movement

During combat, creatures can employ multiple mechanics that allow them to move around the battlefield. The most common of those mechanics is the Advance or Disengage move action (detailed under Move Actions below), but abilities granted by your class, equipment, ancestry, title, or other options might allow you other ways to move.

Your hero starts with a speed granted by their ancestry—usually 5. This represents the maximum number of squares you can move when you take the Advance move action or when another effect allows you to move. Your speed can be increased by your kit and other game options.

All squares adjacent to your character cost 1 movement to move into. No, there’s no Pythagorean theorem on the grid. It’s a game, don’t overthink it.

Your hero can move freely through an ally’s space. You can move through an enemy’s space, but that space is difficult terrain (see below). You can’t stop moving in any other creature’s space, including to make a strike or use a main action or maneuver while in that space and then continuing your move, unless that creature’s size is two or more sizes greater or smaller than your own.

At the Director’s discretion, you can be forced into the same space as another creature whose size is within 1 of yours, such as by falling down a narrow shaft with such a creature already at the bottom. When you are squeezed into the same space as another creature whose size is within 1 of yours, your ability rolls and tests take a bane.

Target Text:
無需動作的行為

免費機動動作涵蓋了你在回合中想進行的大多數簡單行為。在不是你的回合時，若經過導演同意，你通常可以執行更簡單的免動作行為。例如，大聲向盟友發出警告，或是丟下道具讓其他生物撿取，這些都不需要動作。

導演可以限制你在非自己回合時能執行的免動作行為。例如，當盟友或敵人的回合正在進行時，你可以不需要使用動作就向盟友大喊提醒有看不見的敵人，但若你想在別人的回合中給予盟友複雜的戰術建議，導演可能會要求你必須在自己的回合使用免費機動動作才能這麼做。
Source Text:
No-Action Activities

Free maneuvers cover most of the simple activities you might want to undertake on your turn. When it isn’t your turn, you can typically undertake even simpler activities requiring no action with the Director’s approval. For instance, shouting out a warning to an ally or dropping an item so another creature can pick it up require no action.

The Director can limit what kinds of no-action activities you can attempt when it isn’t your turn. For instance, shouting out a warning about an unseen foe to an ally on the ally’s or the foe’s turn requires no action. But the Director might stop you from giving that ally complex tactical advice when it isn’t your turn, saying that doing so instead requires a free maneuver on your turn.

Target Text:
騎乘

你必須騎乘在其他生物身上才能使用騎乘移動動作（詳見下文「騎乘戰鬥」）。當你使用騎乘移動動作時，坐騎可以載你移動最多等於坐騎速度的格數。或者，你也可以使用騎乘移動動作，讓坐騎以免費反應動作執行撤離移動動作。你每輪只能使用 1 次騎乘移動動作，而坐騎每輪也只能被施加此移動動作 1 次。你可以隨意將這段騎乘拆分到在其他機動動作和主要動作之間。
Source Text:
Ride

A creature can take the Ride move action only while mounted on another creature (see Mounted Combat below). When a creature takes the Ride move action, they cause their mount to move up to the mount’s speed, taking the rider with them. Alternatively, a creature can use the Ride move action to have their mount use the Disengage move action as a free triggered action. A creature can use the Ride move action only once per round. A mounted creature can only have this move action applied to them once per round. This movement can be broken up with the rider’s maneuver and main action however they wish.

Target Text:
搜索隱藏生物

你可以使用搜索隱藏生物機動動作來嘗試尋找對你隱藏的生物（詳見第 9 章〈考驗〉的「躲藏與潛行」）。
Source Text:
Search for Hidden Creatures

The Search for Hidden Creatures maneuver allows a creature to attempt to locate creatures hidden from them (see Hide and Sneak in Chapter 9: Tests).

Target Text:
起身

若你處於伏地狀態，你可以使用起身機動動作站起來並解除伏地狀態。此外，你也可以使用此機動動作讓 1 個相鄰且自願的伏地生物站起來。
Source Text:
Stand Up

A creature can use the Stand Up maneuver to stand up if they are prone, ending that condition. Alternatively, they can use this maneuver to make a willing adjacent prone creature stand up.

Target Text:
反應動作與免費反應動作

你的英雄可能擁有 1 個或多個獨特的反應動作，每個都有特定的觸發條件。無論是在自己的回合或其他生物的回合，你每輪只能使用 1 次反應動作，而且只有在該反應動作的觸發條件發生時才能使用。例如，熾怒者可以使用【Lines of Force】反應動作來強制移動目標，但只有在敵人先嘗試強制移動熾怒者或附近另一個生物後才能使用。

免費反應動作遵循反應動作的相同規則，但不會計入每輪只能使用 1 次反應動作的限制。例如，影舞者可以在另一名英雄結束回合時，以【Hesitation Is Weakness】招式回應該觸發條件並進行自己的回合。不過，由於這個招式是免費反應動作，影舞者在該輪稍後仍然可以使用【In All This Confusion】反應動作。

若有某個觸發條件同時觸發多個反應動作，英雄和任何由玩家控制的生物可以自行決定這些反應動作的執行順序。之後，導演再為他控制的生物決定執行順序。

Source Text:
Triggered Actions and Free Triggered Actions

Your hero might have one or more unique triggered actions, each of which has a specified trigger that allows the action to be used. You can use one triggered action per round, either on your turn or another creature’s turn, but only when the action’s trigger occurs. For instance, a fury hero can use the Lines of Force triggered action to force move a target, but only after an enemy has first tried to force move the fury or another nearby creature.

A free triggered action follows the same rules as a triggered action, but it doesn’t count against your limit of one triggered action per round. For instance, a shadow hero can use their Hesitation Is Weakness ability to take their turn in response to the trigger of another hero ending their turn. But because that ability is a free triggered action, the shadow can still use their In All This Confusion triggered action later in the round.

If multiple triggered actions occur in response to the same trigger, any heroes and other player-controlled creatures taking a triggered action or a free triggered action decide among themselves which of those triggered actions are resolved first. Then the Director decides the same for creatures they control.

Any effect that prevents you from using triggered actions also prevents you from using free triggered actions.

Target Text:
進行回合

戰鬥中的每個生物，無論是英雄、敵人或其他生物，在各自的回合中都能進行 1 個主要動作、1 個機動動作，以及 1 個移動動作。每個參戰者都可以自由決定機動動作和主要動作的執行順序，也可以在機動動作和主要動作之前、之後或之間，靈活運用移動動作提供的移動距離。

你也可以將主要動作轉換成移動動作或機動動作，這樣你就可以在自己的回合執行 2 個移動動作 + 1 個機動動作，或是 2 個機動動作 + 1 個移動動作。

下文會詳細說明移動動作如何運作，以及你的英雄可以使用哪些通用的機動動作和主要動作。對於規則中沒有特別列出的行為（例如砍斷吊燈讓它砸向敵人），由導演決定該行為屬於機動動作或主要動作。
Source Text:
Taking a Turn

Each creature in combat—whether hero, adversary, or something in between—gets to take a main action, a maneuver, and a move action on their turn (explained later in this chapter). Each combatant can perform their maneuver and main action in any order, and can break up the movement granted by their move action before, after, or between their maneuver and main action however they like. You can also turn your main action into a move action or a maneuver, so that your turn can alternatively consist of two move actions and a maneuver, or two maneuvers and a move action.

The Movement section below breaks down how your move action works, while the Maneuvers and Main Actions sections break down the baseline maneuvers and main actions your character can undertake. For any activities not specifically covered in those rules, such as cutting down a chandelier to drop on enemies, the Director decides whether such an activity is a maneuver or a main action.

Source Text: You can carve a rune onto your skin with 10 uninterrupted minutes of work, which is activated by the magic within your body. The rune you carve determines the benefit you receive, chosen from among the following:

Source Text: As a maneuver, you can communicate telepathically with a willing creature you have met before and who is within 1 mile of you. You must know the creature’s name, and they must speak and understand a language you know. You and the creature can respond to one another as if having a spoken conversation. You can communicate with a different creature by changing the rune.

Target Text: 矮人是擁有岩石皮膚的類人生物，身材矮壯。許多矮人會在自己的皮膚刻下超常符文，有些人的鬍鬚甚至由水晶構成。
Source Text: Humanoids with stony skin, dwarves have short and stout bodies. Many carve supernatural runes into their flesh, and some have beards made of crystals.

Target Text: 你強健的體魄讓你不會失去力量。你不會陷入虛弱狀態。

Source Text: Your heavy stone body and connection to the earth make it difficult for others to move you. You have a +1 bonus to stability.
Forge Steel Source Text: Your heavy stone body and connection to the earth make it difficult for others to move you.
Forge Steel Target Text: 你岩石般的厚重身軀與大地緊密相連，讓他人難以移動你。

Source Text: Your stone skin affords you potent protection. You have a +6 bonus to Stamina, and that bonus increases by 6 at 4th, 7th, and 10th levels.
Forge Steel Source Text: Your stone skin affords you potent protection.
Forge Steel Target Text: 你的石質皮膚能為你提供強大的防護。

Source Text: Spark Off Your Skin

Target Text: 你的身軀天生能承受敵人的猛烈攻擊。抵抗效力時，你的力量會視為提高 1 點。此外，當你需要進行力量考驗來抵抗環境效果或生物的特性與招式時，你會獲得 1 個優勢。

Forge Steel Target Text: 你的身軀天生能承受敵人的猛烈攻擊。

Target Text: 矮人英雄可以獲得以下特性。
Source Text: Dwarf heroes have access to the following traits.

Target Text: 儘管哈肯人天性友善外向，但只要他們罕見地出現在人類社會中，都會被視為黑暗的預兆。
Source Text: In spite of their friendly, outgoing nature, the rare presence of a hakaan in human society is considered a harbinger. An omen of dark times.

Target Text: 哈肯人源自北方華尼伽的巨人部落，最早的哈肯人部落與華尼伽的詭計之神霍卡提雅達成交易，用部分體型和力量換取了預見未來的能力。
Source Text: Descended from a tribe of giants in upper Vanigar, the original Haka’an tribe made a bargain with Holkatya the Vanigar trickster god. They traded some of their gigantic size and strength for the ability to see the future.

Target Text: 但是霍卡提雅背叛了他們，哈肯人唯一能夠預見的未來就是自己死亡的時刻與方式。這些異象都不是一些平凡瑣碎的悲劇，沒有哈肯人曾預見自己會被葡萄噎死。這種「命定末視」總是意義重大，總是戲劇性十足。
Source Text: But Holkatya betrayed them, and the only future a hakaan is allowed to see is the moment and nature of their own death. These visions are never of some mundane tragedy. No hakaan ever received a vision of dying from choking on a grape. This Doomsight is always momentous. Always dramatic.

Target Text: 命定末視可能會在任何時刻降臨，而且只有少數哈肯人擁有，但當它來臨時，置之不理被認為是極度狂妄自大的行為。試圖逃避命定末視不僅會導致痛苦與悲慘的死亡，還會讓你的家族蒙受永遠的恥辱。
Source Text: The Doomsight can happen at any moment. It does not come for all or even most hakaan, but when it comes, it is considered an act of overwhelming hubris to ignore it. Trying to escape the Doomsight means a painful, tragic death, and cursing your family to live with shame.

Target Text: 一般人類所遇見的哈肯人，通常都是正在試圖實現自身命運的人。人類的迷信認為哈肯人的出現是世界大勢正在轉變的徵兆，這點其實完全符合事實。在黑暗時期，許多哈肯人會經歷命定末視，離開自己的社區，踏入凡人的世界，尋找命中注定的結局。
Source Text: But the only hakaan the average human meets is one trying to fulfill their doom. The human superstition—that the arrival of one or more hakaan in human lands is a sign of great forces acting in the world, auspicious times—is literally true. In dark times, many hakaan experience the Doomsight and leave their communities to venture out into the mundane world, in search of their destiny.

Target Text: 華尼伽的人類有個特定的詞語來描述個人宿命的概念：「Wyrd」，所以傳統哈肯人有時也會稱命定末視為「Wyrdken」。
Source Text: Humans in Vanigar have their own word for this concept of a personal fate. “Wyrd.” Traditional hakaan sometimes refer to the Doomsight as “wyrdken.”

Source Text: Your stature reflects your giant forebears. Your size is 1L.

Target Text: 大個子！
Source Text: Big!

Target Text: 強壯的哈肯人是石巨人的後裔，身高超過 9 呎，擁有肌肉發達、由有機岩石構成的身軀。他們是核心規則中體型最大的族裔！
Source Text: Descended from stone giants, the mighty hakaan stand over 9 feet tall and have well-muscled bodies made of organic stone. They are the largest ancestry in this book!

Source Text: You are exceptionally strong. You gain an edge on tests made to lift and haul heavy objects.

Target Text: 輕如鴻毛
Source Text: All Is a Feather

Target Text: 與你的導演合作，你可以預先決定哪場遭遇你將會死亡。當該遭遇開始時，你會進入「命定」狀態。處於命定狀態時，你進行的任何考驗和招式檢定都會自動獲得 T3 結果，而且無論你的體力降到多低都不會死亡。然而，你會在遭遇結束時立刻死亡，而且無法透過任何方式復活。
Source Text: Working with your Director, you can predetermine an encounter in which you will die. When that encounter begins, you become doomed. While doomed, you automatically obtain a tier 3 outcome on tests and ability rolls, and you don’t die no matter how low your Stamina falls. You then die immediately at the end of the encounter, and can’t be returned to life by any means.

Target Text: 若你沒有預先決定死亡遭遇，你也可以在陷入瀕死時進入命定狀態（無需動作，但需經導演同意）。這種選擇應該保留給因為英勇行為而瀕死的情況，例如與首領殊死一戰、拯救平民，或因為先前的行為而遭遇相應的後果，而不是單純因為你只玩一場冒險而沒有顧忌。
Source Text: If you don’t predetermine your death encounter, you can choose to become doomed while you are dying with the Director’s approval (no action required). Doing so should be reserved for encounters in which you are dying as a result of suitable heroism, such as making a last stand against a boss or saving civilians, or when the consequences of your actions have finally caught up to you—not because you’re playing a one-shot and have nothing to lose, Hacaarl.

Target Text: 此外，若你的體力降至疲態值的負數，但未處於命定狀態，你會變成碎石，而非死亡。在這種情況下，你無法感知周圍環境，也無法以任何方式恢復體力或復原。在 12 小時後，你會恢復等於你復元值的體力。
Source Text: Additionally, when your Stamina reaches the negative of your winded value and you are not doomed, you turn to rubble instead of experiencing death. You are unaware of your surroundings in this state, and you can’t regain Stamina or have this effect undone in any way. After 12 hours, you regain Stamina equal to your recovery value.

Target Text: 高等精靈是玄暉天靈後裔，負責管理圖書館並擔任僕從與使者。高等精靈的歷史記載著一個更美好的時代——在人類與戰爭尚未到來、天靈仍在凡間、萬物只追求藝術與美麗的時代。
Source Text: Children of the solar celestials created to tend their libraries and attend to the true elves as heralds, high elf history describes a better age, before the coming of humans and war. A time when the celestials were still in the world, and all that mattered was art and beauty.

Target Text: 在創造者退隱至阿卡迪亞的千年歲月中，高等精靈建立了自己的文明，主要居住在已經從空中墜落的天靈城市裡。雖然沒有了需要服侍的創造者，但精靈們仍然延續以前的生活方式，收集典籍和知識，追求藝術。然而，隨著世代更迭，他們變得越來越封閉，也越來越不信任外來者。
Source Text: In the millennia since their creators retired to Arcadia, the high elves built a civilization for themselves, primarily living in and among the fallen celestial sky cities. With no creators left to please, the elves continue as they did before—collecting lore and knowledge, worshipping art, and turning more inward and distrusting of outsiders with each generation.

Target Text: 高等精靈
Source Text: High Elf
Forge Steel Source Text: Elf (high)
Forge Steel Target Text: 高等精靈

Source Text: You have 3 ancestry points to spend on the following traits.

Target Text: 速選：敏銳感官、非凡優雅。
Source Text: Quick Build: High Senses, Otherworldly Grace.

Target Text: 你的魔法魅力會讓人不自覺地被你吸引。每當你使用魅惑或遊說技能進行氣場考驗時，你會獲得 1 個優勢。由於每個人喜歡的特徵不盡相同，這種魔法魅力會讓你在每個生物眼中呈現出略為不同的外表與聲音。不過，你看起來仍然是自己的模樣，不會被誤認為其他人。
Source Text: A magic glamor makes others perceive you as interesting and engaging, granting you an edge on Presence tests using the Flirt or Persuade skills. This glamor makes you appear and sound slightly different to each creature you meet, since what is engaging to one might be different for another. However, you never appear to be anyone other than yourself.

Target Text: 高等精靈端莊優雅，擁有高挑纖細的身軀、尖耳，以及比大多數類人生物更光滑的皮膚。金、鉑、鈀、銥等稀有金屬鑲嵌物會成為他們皮膚中的有機構造。由於超常魅術的影響，多數人看不見高等精靈最真實的模樣（有時甚至連他們自己也看不見），這種魅術會讓高等精靈在他人眼中更具吸引力，而每個人對「吸引力」的理解可能各不相同。魅術不只影響外表，也會稍微改變高等精靈的聲音和氣味。
Source Text: Stately and graceful, high elves have tall, willowy bodies, pointed ears, and smoother skin than most other humanoids. Rare metal inlays such as gold, platinum, palladium, and iridium act as organic components within their skin. The truest form of any high elf is hidden from most—sometimes even from themself—thanks to a supernatural glamor that makes them more attractive to others, whatever that might mean to an individual. This glamor transcends physical appearance, also slightly altering a high elf’s tone and smell.

Target Text: 當敵人攻擊你時，你可以反轉魅術的魔力，將恐懼注入對方心中。每當你受到生物造成的傷害時，你可以使用反應動作讓該生物對你陷入畏縮狀態，直到他下個回合結束。
Source Text: When a foe strikes, you reverse the magic of your glamor to instill fear into their heart. Whenever you take damage from a creature, you can use a triggered action to make that creature frightened of you until the end of their next turn.

Target Text: 恐怖魅術
Source Text: Glamor of Terror

Target Text: 當你執行撤離移動動作時，你的遁移距離 +1。
Source Text: You gain a +1 bonus to the distance you can shift when you take the Disengage move action.

Target Text: 優雅撤離
Source Text: Graceful Retreat

Target Text: 你擁有非常敏銳的感知能力。當你進行察覺威脅的考驗時，你會獲得 1 個優勢。
Source Text: Your senses are especially keen and perceptive. You gain an edge on tests made to notice threats.

Target Text: 敏銳感官
Source Text: High Senses

Target Text: 你的精靈身軀與心智難以被拘束。每當你進行豁免時，擲出 5 以上就算成功。
Source Text: Your elf body and mind can’t be contained for long. Whenever you make a saving throw, you succeed on a roll of 5 or higher.

Target Text: 非凡優雅
Source Text: Otherworldly Grace

Target Text: 對你而言，重拾記憶就像活在當下一樣自然。當你進行回想知識的考驗時，你會獲得 1 個優勢。
Source Text: Accessing memories is as easy as living in the present for you. You gain an edge on tests made to recall lore.

Target Text: 重溫記憶
Source Text: Revisit Memory

Target Text: 你的心智能讓你在任何情況下保持專注。你不會陷入暈眩狀態。
Source Text: Your mind allows you to maintain your focus in any situation. You can’t be made dazed.
Forge Steel Source Text: Your mind allows you to maintain your focus in any situation.
Forge Steel Target Text: 你的心智能讓你在任何情況下保持專注。

Target Text: 頑強心智
Source Text: Unstoppable Mind

Source Text: High Elf Traits

Target Text: 高等精靈英雄可以獲得以下特性。
Source Text: High elf heroes have access to the following traits.

Target Text: 人類與這個世界的連結，與其他會說話的族群截然不同。你可以感知超自然的存在，據說就像空氣中瀰漫著油膩的氣味。不死者一靠近，你後頸的寒毛就會豎起，這也解釋了墓地為何會對你們產生如此強烈的影響。無論是哪種魔法，都無法完全束縛你；無論是什麼力量在驅使著不死者，你都會本能地抗拒。
Source Text: Humans belong to the world in a way the other speaking peoples do not. You can sense the presence of the supernatural—that … oily smell in the air, as I’ve heard it described. And the presence of deathless causes the hairs on the back of your neck to stand up. Or why do you think graveyards affect you so? Whatever magic is, its grip on you is light. Whatever drives the deathless, your nature rebels against it.

Target Text: 「沒有人知道為什麼會這樣。我們精靈並不具備這種感知能力，元素生物、矮人和歐克也沒有。究竟是什麼讓人類如此特別？我是歷史學家，不是醫生，無法給你答案。或許有朝一日，你們當中的某個人會找出真相，並向所有人揭示其中的奧祕。」
Source Text: “No one knows why this should be. We elves have no such senses. Nor do the elementals or the kanin … the dwarves and the orcs as you say. What is it that sets humans apart? I am an historian, not a physician. I cannot say. Perhaps some of you will one day find out and teach us all the reason.”

Source Text: Human

Source Text: Quick Build: Perseverance, Staying Power.

Target Text: 使用機動動作，你可以啟動感知能力來偵測超常生物和現象。直到你下個回合結束前，你知道 5 格內任何超常物體、亡靈、構裝體或異界生物的位置，即使你對他們沒有效果線也能如此。你能分辨偵測到的是物體還是生物，並且能知道那些生物的本質。
Source Text: As a maneuver, you can open your awareness to detect supernatural creatures and phenomena. Until the end of your next turn, you know the location of any supernatural object, or any undead, construct, or creature from another world within 5 squares, even if you don’t have line of effect to that object or creature. You know if you’re detecting an item or a creature, and you know the nature of any creature you detect.

Target Text: 偵測超常
Source Text: Detect the Supernatural

Target Text: 人類是歐爾登及許多奇幻世界中人口最多的族群！《Draw Steel》中的人類與現實世界的人類一樣，具有豐富的多樣性，甚至還能感知超常能量的存在！
Source Text: Humans are the most numerous people in Orden and many other fantasy worlds! In Draw Steel, humans have all the diversity that our species displays in real life—and they can sense the presence of supernatural energy!

Target Text: 你與大自然的連結能讓你抵抗某些超常效果。你可以無視魔法或靈能招式所創造的臨時困難地形。此外，當你被魔法或靈能招式強制移動時，你可以將強制移動的距離 -1。
Source Text: Your connection to the natural world allows you to resist certain supernatural effects. You ignore temporary difficult terrain created by magic and psionic abilities. Additionally, when you are force moved by a magic or psionic ability, you can reduce the forced movement distance by 1.

Target Text: 難以牽制
Source Text: Can’t Take Hold

Target Text: 你可以忍受痛苦和壓力，在困境中堅持前行。若你處於畏縮、緩速或虛弱狀態，你可以使用機動動作立刻解除其中 1 種狀態。
Source Text: A tolerance for pain and distress allows you to push through difficult situations. If you are frightened, slowed, or weakened, you can use a maneuver to immediately end one of those conditions.

Target Text: 堅定決心
Source Text: Determination

Target Text: 你絕不輕言放棄。當你使用耐力技能進行考驗時，你會獲得 1 個優勢。此外，若你處於緩速狀態，你的速度會降至 3，而非 2。
Source Text: Giving up is for other people. You gain an edge on tests made using the Endurance skill. Additionally, when you are slowed, your speed is reduced to 3 instead of 2.
Forge Steel Source Text: When you are slowed, your speed is reduced to 3 instead of 2.
Forge Steel Target Text: 若你處於緩速狀態，你的速度會降至 3，而非 2。

Target Text: 堅持不懈
Source Text: Perseverance
Forge Steel Source Text: Perseverence
Forge Steel Target Text: 堅持不懈

Source Text: Your instinctive resilience protects you from injuries beyond the routine. Whenever you take damage that isn’t untyped, you can use a triggered action to take half the damage.

Target Text: 抵抗異常
Source Text: Resist the Unnatural

Forge Steel Source Text: Your human physiology allows you to fight, run, and stay awake longer than others.
Forge Steel Target Text: 人類的生理構造能讓你比其他族群更持久地戰鬥、奔跑和保持清醒。

Target Text: 梅莫人是「至律位面」公理界的原生族裔。他們居住的土地一樣有湖泊、樹木、飛鳥和花朵，但在這個異世界中，湖泊是由水銀構成、鳥兒拍打著薄如蟬翼的玻璃翅膀，而花瓣雖然是虹彩金屬，卻如同塵世的玫瑰般柔軟易碎。
Source Text: The native denizens of Axiom, the Plane of Uttermost Law, memonek dwell in a land with lakes and trees and birds and flowers. But on this alien world, the lakes are seas of mercury, the birds glitter with wings of glass stretched gossamer thin, and the flowers’ petals are iridescent metal as flexible and fragile as any earthly rose.

Target Text: 梅莫人的思維極度有序，理性是他們最引以為傲的特質。然而，當他們來到較低層的位面時（尤其是像歐爾登這樣秩序與混亂交織的衍界），他們便會遭受一種病症的侵襲，讓他們難以控制自己。那種病叫作「情緒」。
Source Text: The minds of memonek are highly ordered. Their reason is their great pride. But when descending to the lower planes, including a manifold like Orden where law and chaos mix, a sickness comes over them—an uncontrollable sensation called emotion.

Target Text: 梅莫人
Source Text: Memonek

Source Text: Purchased Memonek Traits

Source Text: Your silicone body is low in density. Whenever you fall, you reduce the distance of the fall by 2 squares.

Target Text: 輕盈落地
Source Text: Fall Lightly

Source Text: Your body is light for a creature of your height. Whenever another creature attempts to force move you, you treat your size as one size smaller than it is.

Target Text: 身輕如燕
Source Text: Lightweight

Target Text: 梅莫人源自「至律位面」公理界，是由金屬、大理石、玻璃和其他無機材料構成的機械族群。他們的身體很輕，因此更容易被移動，墜落速度也較慢。
Source Text: Originating on Axiom, the Plane of Uttermost Law, memonek are a machine people made of metal, marble, glass, and other inorganic materials. Their bodies are lightweight, making them easier to move and letting them fall at slower speeds.

Target Text: 憑藉你守序的天性和敏捷的反應，你絕對不會對試圖穿過你的生物手下留情。除非你允許，否則敵人無法穿越你占據的空間。
Source Text: Your lawful nature and quick reflexes mean you give no quarter to creatures trying to get past you. Enemies can’t move through your space unless you allow them to do so.

Target Text: 吾即律法
Source Text: I Am Law

Target Text: 你與「至律位面」公理界的連結能讓你控制周圍的混亂。每輪 1 次，當你自己或 1 個與你相鄰的生物進行檢定時，你可以使用免費反應動作，移除該次檢定的 1 個優勢或劣勢、將雙優勢轉為單優勢，或將雙劣勢轉為單劣勢。
Source Text: Your connection to Axiom, the plane of Uttermost Law, allows you to manage chaos around you. Once per round when you or an adjacent creature makes a power roll, you can use a free triggered action to remove an edge or a bane on the roll, to turn a double edge into an edge, or to turn a double bane into a bane.

Target Text: 秩序守護者
Source Text: Keeper of Order

Target Text: 你的身體可以達到驚人的移動速度。你的速度為 7。
Source Text: You can push your body to move at incredible speeds. Your speed is 7.
Forge Steel Source Text: You can push your body to move at incredible speeds. Your Speed is 7.
Forge Steel Target Text: 你的身體可以達到驚人的移動速度。你的速度為 7。

Source Text: Lightning Nimbleness

Source Text: Your connection to Axiom allows you to regulate your movement. You can’t be made slowed.
Forge Steel Source Text: Your connection to Axiom allows you to regulate your movement.
Forge Steel Target Text: 你與公理界的連結能讓你調節自身的移動力。

Target Text: 奔騰不息
Source Text: Nonstop

Source Text: You gain an edge on tests made to parse schematics, maps, and other systematic documents that aren’t inherently chaotic. In addition, you treat any language you don’t know as if you know a related language.
Forge Steel Source Text: You treat any language you don’t know as if you know a related language.
Forge Steel Target Text: 對於任何你不懂的語言，你都視為懂得某種與之相關的語言。

Target Text: 條理思維

Target Text: 你有條不紊的心智讓你不會驚慌失措。你不會措手不及。
Source Text: Your ordered mind can’t be caught off guard. You can’t be made surprised.

Target Text: 泰然自若
Source Text: Unphased

Target Text: 維洛帕拉症（俗稱躍界病）或許會妨礙你，但你也知道如何將自己的痛苦轉化為敵人能夠感受到的力量。每場戰鬥開始時，你會獲得 1 點鬥志。
Source Text: Velloparatha—the worldsickness—might hinder you, but you know how to turn your pain into something your enemies feel. At the start of any combat, you gain 1 surge.
Forge Steel Source Text: Velloparatha - the worldsickness - might hinder, but you know how to turn your pain into something your enemies feel.
Forge Steel Target Text: 維洛帕拉症（俗稱躍界病）或許會妨礙你，但你也知道如何將自己的痛苦轉化為敵人能夠感受到的力量。

Source Text: Memonek Traits

Target Text: 梅莫人英雄可以獲得以下特性。
Source Text: Memonek heroes have access to the following traits.

Target Text: 歐克擁有無法掩藏的憤怒，以及驅使他們作戰的狂暴，以稱霸沙場的精銳戰士聞名於世，但這支愛好和平的族裔卻不喜歡承擔這樣的名聲。
Source Text: An anger that cannot be hidden. A fury that drives them in battle. Orcs are famed throughout the world as consummate warriors—a reputation that the peace-loving orcs find distasteful.

Target Text: 作為第五支會說話的族群，歐克在人類與精靈之後來到歐爾登。他們在兩種文明的邊境地帶建立家園，喜愛自然森林，也懂得迴避精靈盤據的幻林。然而，儘管他們再怎麼小心，幾個世代之後，人類開墾的道路與建設的農場，仍然不可避免地連接到他們聚落的外牆。
Source Text: The fifth of the speaking peoples, orcs arrived on Orden after humans and elves. They made their homes in the borderlands between those two cultures, preferring the natural forests and avoiding the elf-haunted wodes. For generations, this put them directly in the path of humans who cut down the trees and built roads and farms.

Target Text: 每個歐克體內都蘊藏著一團火焰，一旦流血，就會讓他們的血管發光，這股憤怒會驅使他們戰鬥到生命的盡頭。他們既渴望平靜，又在戰鬥中展現熱情，這種矛盾被一句矮人諺語恰如其分地概括：
Source Text: Each orc has within them a fire that causes their veins to glow once blood is drawn. This anger propels them right to the edge of death. The dichotomy between their desire to be left alone and their zeal in battle is summarized in a dwarf proverb:

Target Text: 「感謝歐克不會記仇。」
Source Text: “Be thankful orcs do not hold grudges.”

Target Text: 歐克
Source Text: Orc

Target Text: 自購歐克特性
Source Text: Purchased Orc Traits

Target Text: 你有 3 點族裔點數，可以用來購買以下特性。
Source Text: You have 3 ancestry points to spend on the following traits.

Target Text: 速選：熾熱復元、腳踏實地
Source Text: Quick Build: Glowing Recovery, Grounded.

Target Text: 每當 1 個生物造成的傷害讓你陷入瀕死時，你可以對任意生物發動 1 次基礎打擊。若該生物因為你的打擊而體力歸 0，你可以花費 1 點復元力。
Source Text: Whenever a creature deals damage to you that leaves you dying, you can make a free strike against any creature. If the creature is reduced to 0 Stamina by your strike, you can spend a Recovery.

Target Text: 絕地反擊
Source Text: Relentless

Target Text: 歐克的膚色呈現各種綠色調，身形比人類略高，也更寬壯。他們的血液中流淌著一種名為「血焰」的超常能量，當歐克面臨存亡之際，這股能量會點亮皮膚上的彩色紋路。
Source Text: Orcs have skin in green tones and stand slightly taller and wider than humans. A supernatural energy they call “the blood fire” flows through their veins, igniting colorful lines in an orc’s skin during life-or-death battles.

Target Text: 你體內奔流的魔力能讓你在戰鬥狂潮中跑得更快。每輪 1 次，當你首次受到傷害時，你的速度會 +2，直到該輪結束。
Source Text: The magic coursing through your veins makes you run faster in the heat of battle. The first time in any combat round that you take damage, you gain a +2 bonus to speed until the end of the round.

Target Text: 血焰衝刺
Source Text: Bloodfire Rush

Target Text: 你的血焰能讓你比其他人更快恢復體力。每當你使用喘息機動動作時，你可以花費任意數量的復元力。
Source Text: Your bloodfire allows you to regain your strength quicker than others. Whenever you use the Catch Breath maneuver, you can spend as many Recoveries as you like.

Target Text: 熾熱復元
Source Text: Glowing Recovery

Target Text: 你血液中的魔力讓他人難以移動你。你的穩度 +1。
Source Text: The magic in your blood makes it difficult for others to move you. You have a +1 bonus to stability.
Forge Steel Source Text: The magic in your blood makes it difficult for others to move you.
Forge Steel Target Text: 你血液中的魔力讓他人難以移動你。

Target Text: 腳踏實地
Source Text: Grounded

Source Text: Your bloodfire supplies you with a constant rush of adrenaline. You can’t be made slowed.
Forge Steel Source Text: Your bloodfire supplies you with a constant rush of adrenaline.
Forge Steel Target Text: 你的血焰讓你的腎上腺素持續翻湧。

Source Text: When you are stirred by a passion for creation, your bloodfire allows you to work longer and harder. When you gain your initial skills from your career, culture, class, or other source, choose two skills from the crafting skill group, whether you have those skills or not. Whenever you make a project roll for a crafting project that uses these skills, you gain a +2 bonus to the roll.

Source Text: Passionate Artisan

Target Text: 歐克特性
Source Text: Orc Traits

Target Text: 歐克英雄可以獲得以下特性。
Source Text: Orc heroes have access to the following traits.

Target Text: 在歐爾登，波德人的數量與多元性僅次於人類。雖然他們不是人類，卻與人類共同生活，共享同樣的神明與文化。幾乎在每一種人類文化中，都能找到波德人聖者，或是受到波德人敬奉的人類聖者。
Source Text: After humans, polders are the most numerous and diverse ancestry in Orden. They are not humans, but they live in and among humans and share their gods and culture. Almost every human culture in Orden has a polder saint or a human saint venerated by polder.

Target Text: 波德人身材矮小，平均身高僅 3 呎半，起源也撲朔迷離。作為一支年輕的族裔，他們和人類一樣沒有專屬的守護神。他們天生擁有融入陰影的能力，因此獲得了優秀間諜和盜賊的名聲。然而，許多波德人認為這是一種污衊，並強調他們同樣以精湛的廚藝聞名。實際上，波德人遍布各行各業，尤其活躍於城市之中。
Source Text: Short, averaging 3-1/2 feet tall, the polders’ origins are obscure. They are a young species who, like humans, have no single patron god. Their ability to shadowmeld means they enjoy a reputation as excellent spies and thieves. Many polders consider this a base slander and point out they’re also famed as chefs, though polders can be found in every profession, especially in cities.

Target Text: 波德人
Source Text: Polder

Target Text: 自購波德人特性
Source Text: Purchased Polder Traits

Target Text: 你有 4 點族裔點數，可以用來購買以下特性。
Source Text: You have 4 ancestry points to spend on the following traits.

Source Text: Quick Build: Corruption Immunity, Fearless, Graceful Retreat.

Target Text:
你將自己化為平貼於牆面或地面的影子。此時，若你對 1 個生物具有掩護或遮蔽，或該生物觀察不到你，你就會對他處於隱藏。在影子形態中，你能完全感知周遭的環境，而且對你發動的任何打擊和搜索考驗都會承受 1 個劣勢。你無法移動或被強制移動，也無法執行主要動作和機動動作（除了脫離此形態或指揮受你控制的生物，例如你發動招式召喚的生物）。影響多格的招式或效果，只有在明確影響你所貼附的表面時，你才會受到影響。你可以使用機動動作脫離此形態。

若你所貼附的表面被摧毀，此招式會立刻終止，而且你會受到 1d6 點傷害（無法以任何方式減免）。
Source Text: You flatten yourself into a shadow against a wall or floor you are touching, and become hidden from any creature you have cover or concealment from or who isn’t observing you. While in shadow form, you have full awareness of your surroundings, and strikes made against you and tests made to search for you take a bane. You can’t move or be force moved, and you can’t take main actions or maneuvers except to exit this form or to direct creatures under your control, such as one you summon using an ability. Any ability or effect that targets more than 1 square affects you in this form only if it explicitly affects the surface you are flattened against. You can exit this form as a maneuver. If the surface you are flattened against is destroyed, this ability ends and you take 1d6 damage that can’t be reduced in any way.

Source Text: Shadowmeld

Target Text: 你化為一道真正的影子。

Source Text: Your innate shadow magic grants you resilience against the unnatural. You have corruption immunity equal to your level + 2.

Forge Steel Target Text: 你天生勇敢無懼。

Source Text: Your small size makes it easier for you to slip away from the fray. You gain a +1 bonus to the distance you can shift when you take the Disengage move action.

Forge Steel Target Text: 你矮小的體型能讓你更容易從混戰中溜走。

Source Text: A light step serves you well when speed is of the essence. You ignore the effects of difficult terrain and can move at full speed while sneaking.

Source Text: Nimblestep

Target Text: 避開他人的注意力能讓你的行動更加自由。在戰鬥中，每當你的回合開始時，若沒有任何敵人對你有效果線，或你對任何有效果線的敵人處於隱藏或具有遮蔽，你的速度會 +3，直到你當前回合結束。

Target Text: 庫蘭佐伊最初是心語者（擁有近乎神級力量的邪惡靈能者）的奴隸種族，他們在第一次靈能大戰期間成功解放了自己。在之後的數百年間，他們作為時界的遊牧民族，建立了自己的文化和文明。「時空獵手」這個稱呼是下層界域的居民賦予的，因為他們看到庫蘭佐伊所使用的先進科技，認為他們必定來自未來。
Source Text: The original servitor species of the synliroi—evil psions with near godlike power—the kuran’zoi liberated themselves during the First Psychic War. In the centuries since, they built their own culture and civilization as nomads of the timescape. The exonym “time raiders” was given to them by denizens of the lower worlds who, seeing the advanced technology the kuran’zoi wield, concluded they must be from the future.

Target Text: 時空獵手在歐爾登極為罕見，但在靈薄風暴肆虐的浩瀚星海之中茁壯成長。
Source Text: Extraordinarily rare in Orden, time raiders thrive on the Sea of Stars, the Sea Between Worlds, where the winds of limbo roar.

Target Text: 庫蘭佐伊沒有眼睛，而是擁有晶體光學感應器，賦予他們高光譜視覺，並能抵禦浩瀚星海的極端輻射。因此，他們只需要戴上便攜式呼吸器就能在星艦外自由活動。時空獵手還具有兩對手臂，能同時使用近戰與遠程武器。一名訓練有素的庫蘭佐伊，就足以抗衡一支完整的作戰小隊。
Source Text: In place of eyes, kuran’zoi possess crystalline ocular sensors that grant them high-spectral vision and which are hardened against the extreme radiations encountered in the Sea of Stars, permitting them to operate freely outside their vessels with only their portable rebreathers. Time raiders also have two sets of arms, allowing them to wield melee weapons at the same time as ranged weapons. A single well-trained kuran’zoi is like a squad unto themself.

You can select one skill from each aspect’s list of options. Target Text: 生活環境是指你的文化通常待在什麼地方。你是住在熱鬧的城市，還是小村莊？也許你在偏遠的修道院長大，或是像流浪者一樣在荒野中到處旅行，從不在同一個地方久留？
Source Text: Your culture’s environment aspect describes where the people of that culture spend most of their time. Is your culture centered in a bustling city or a small village? Did you spend your early life in an isolated monastery? Or did you wander the wilderness, never staying in one place for long?

Target Text: 生活環境
Source Text: Environment

Target Text: 遊牧文化為了生存而不斷從一個地方遷移到另一個地方。遊牧文化的成員可能會跟隨動物遷徙或氣候變化而四處旅行，販售商品或服務，或單純享受充滿全新體驗與形形色色人群的流浪生活方式。在遊牧文化中成長的人會學習如何在荒野中導航，並與他人緊密合作，以求生存。
Source Text: A nomadic culture travels from place to place to survive. Members of a nomadic culture might follow animal migrations or the weather, travel to sell their wares or services, or simply enjoy a restless lifestyle full of new experiences and peoples. Those who grow up in nomadic cultures learn to navigate the wilderness and work closely with others to survive.

Target Text: 遊牧
Source Text: Nomadic

Target Text: 建立文化時，從以下選項中選擇你「生活環境」的面向：遊牧、鄉村、隱居、城市或荒野。你會根據所選的生活環境獲得技能選項。這些生活環境可以出現在任何類型的地形中，無論是地表、地下洞窟、杳無人跡的森林深處，甚至水下。
Source Text: When you build a culture, select its environment aspect from the following options: nomadic, rural, secluded, urban, or wilderness. You gain skill options from your chosen environment. All of these environments can be found in any sort of terrain, whether aboveground, in subterranean caverns, deep in trackless forest, or even underwater.

Target Text:
鄉村文化存在於小鎮、村莊或更小的聚落。住在這些地方的人們通常會耕種土地、與過路旅人交易商品或服務、從海裡捕魚，或從地底開採金屬和寶石。

在人口稀少的環境中，鄉村社區的大多數居民都會學習一門手藝，並傳承對社區生存至關重要的基本知識。例如，如果鄉村只有一名鐵匠，在這位鐵匠年老之前，必須找個學徒在鐵砧旁學習。如果鎮上唯一的祭司感冒了，居民們會希望有位侍僧能在最壞情況發生時穿上那華麗的長袍。
Source Text: A rural culture is one located in a town, village, or smaller settled enclave. People dwelling in such places often cultivate the land, trade goods or services with travelers passing through, harvest fish from the sea, or mine metals and gems from the earth. Living among a small population, most folks in a rural community learn a trade and are handed down bits of essential knowledge to help their community survive. For example, when a rural culture has only one blacksmith, it’s important to have an apprentice already learning at the anvil well before that smith starts to get old. If the only priest in town gets the sniffles, folks want an acolyte ready to wear the fancy robes should the worst occur.

Target Text: 鄉村
Source Text: Rural

Target Text: 技能選項：從工藝類技能或學識類技能中選擇 1 項技能（速選：自然）。
Source Text: Skill Options: One skill from the crafting or lore skill groups. (Quick Build: Nature.)

Target Text:
隱居文化存在於單一且相對狹小的結構中（例如建築物或洞穴），幾乎不會與外界文化有所互動。這類場所大多為修道院、城堡或監獄等建築物或建築群。生活在隱居文化中的人很少有離開家園或與外界文化往來的需求，但他們仍然可以察覺外界文化的存在，以及了解家鄉之外發生的事情。

在狹小空間中共同生活的人，往往會培養出和睦相處的能力。由於隱居環境的活動受限，他們大多將時間投注在學習和自我反思上。
Source Text: A secluded culture is based in one relatively close-quarters structure—a building, a cavern, and so forth—and interacts with other cultures only rarely. Such places are often buildings or complexes such as monasteries, castles, or prisons. Folk in a secluded culture have little or no reason to leave their home or interact with other cultures on the outside, but might have an awareness of those cultures and of events happening beyond their enclave. When people live together in close quarters, they typically learn to get along. They often spend much time in study or introspection, as there is not much else to do in seclusion.

Target Text: 隱居
Source Text: Secluded

Target Text: 技能選項：從交涉類技能或學識類技能中選擇 1 項技能（速選：觀色）。

Target Text: 城市文化始終以城市為中心。這種文化可能會出現在元城的城牆之內（那是一座擁有多元人口的巨大都市）；或在容納地下城市的洞穴網路中形成；又或是在任何人口密集且緊密居住的地方自然發展。城市文化的居民通常善於誤導他人、在人群中自由穿行，以及應對城市生活中無所不在的政治角力。
Source Text: An urban culture is always centered in a city. Such a culture might arise within the walls of Capital, a massive metropolis with a cosmopolitan population; within a network of caverns that hold an underground city; or in any other place where a large population lives relatively close together. The people of urban cultures often learn to effectively misdirect others in order to navigate the crowds and the political machinations that can come with city life.

Target Text: 城市
Source Text: Urban

Target Text: 技能選項：從交涉類技能或諜報類技能中選擇 1 項技能（速選：警覺）。
Source Text: Skill Options: One skill from the interpersonal or intrigue skill groups. (Quick Build: Alertness.)

Target Text: 荒野文化的人民不會試圖征服他們居住的地方，無論是沙漠、森林、沼澤、凍原、海洋，還是更特殊的環境。相反地，荒野文化與大自然和諧共生，從土地獲取食物與庇護。荒野文化可能是守護偏僻幻林的德魯伊結社、潛居在沙漠洞穴中的盜匪隊伍，或是將無路可循的群山視為家園的歐克傭兵團。在荒野文化中成長的人們懂得如何善用土地來滿足生活所需，通常也會親手製作工具與衣物等用品。
Source Text: A wilderness culture doesn’t try to tame the terrain in which its people live, whether desert, forest, swamp, tundra, ocean, or more exotic climes. Instead, the folk of such a culture thrive amid nature, taking their sustenance and shelter from the land. A wilderness culture might be a circle of druids protecting a remote wode, a band of brigands hiding out in desert caves, or a camp of orc mercenaries who call the trackless mountains home. People in a wilderness culture learn how to use the land for all they need to live, typically crafting their own tools, clothing, and more.

Target Text: 荒野
Source Text: Wilderness

Target Text:
官僚文化深深根植於正式的領導制度與成文法律。在這種文化中，成員依據法律獲得不同的權力階級，而統治權則掌握在少數人手中，他們透過血統繼承、民眾投票或其他正式且可量化的標準來獲得權力。大多數官僚社群由一位最高統治者領導，但有些則採用議會制。官僚文化的典型例子包括：設有公會長、司庫、祕書，並訂有會員規章的商業公會；統治一群騎士，而這些騎士又統治農民的封建領主；以及設有階級與成員必須遵守之規則的軍事社會。

在官僚文化中茁壯成長的人並非只是盲目遵守規則。無論是透過曲解、修改或重新詮釋政策，他們都善於運用這些規則來謀取私利並達成個人目標，與立法者建立良好的關係更是成功的關鍵。此外，官僚文化中也有一群人專門在不引人注目的情況下，在嚴格的體制外靈活運作。
Source Text: Bureaucratic cultures are steeped in official leadership and formally recorded laws. Members of such a culture are often ranked in power according to those laws, with a small group of people holding the power to rule according to birthright, popular vote, or some other official and measurable standard. Many bureaucratic communities have one person at the top, though others might be ruled by a council. A trade guild with a guildmaster, treasurer, secretary, and a charter of rules and regulations for membership; a feudal lord who rules over a group of knights who in turn rule over peasants working the land; and a militaristic society with ranks and rules that its people must abide are all examples of bureaucratic cultures. Those who thrive in bureaucratic cultures don’t simply follow the rules. They know how to use those rules to their advantage, either bending, changing, or reinterpreting policy to advance their own interests. Schmoozing with those who make the laws is often key to this approach. Others in a bureaucratic culture might specialize in operating outside the strict regulations that govern the culture without getting caught.

Target Text: 官僚
Source Text: Bureaucratic

Target Text: 技能選項：從交涉類技能或諜報類技能中選擇 1 項技能（速選：遊說）。
Source Text: Skill Options: One skill from the interpersonal or intrigue skill groups. (Quick Build: Persuade.)

Target Text:
平權文化是一個所有成員皆平等的地方，社群會共同做出影響多數成員的重要決策。雖然他們會選出領袖來執行決策並組織事務，但每個人都有相對平等的發言權來決定文化的運作方向，且人人都會為社群的生存與茁壯貢獻心力。成員會分擔治理、勞動、育兒及其他職責。平權文化的典型例子包括：沒有貴族管轄、共同耕作並守護土地的農民團體；人人自由的海盜城市；以及所有成員都能對藝術和行政決策投票的巡迴劇團。

許多平權文化選擇不在已開發地區之內活動，而是主要活躍於荒野、大型聚落的特定區域、城市下水道、被遺忘的廢墟，或其他與世隔絕的地方。即使這些文化本身無害，成員也知道，如果與外人住在同一個地方，外人可能會試圖把規則強加在他們身上。因此，平權文化的人們大多專注於自給自足的生活，同時謹慎地避開其他群體可能帶來的威脅。
Source Text: A communal culture is a place where all members of the culture are considered equal. The community works together to make important decisions that affect the majority of the culture. While they elect leaders to carry out these decisions and organize their efforts, each person has a relatively equal say in how the culture operates, and everyone contributes to help their people survive and thrive. Individuals often share the burdens of governing, physical labor, childcare, and other duties. A collective of farmers who work together to cultivate and protect their land without a noble, a city of pirates where each person can do as they wish, and a traveling theatrical troupe whose members vote on every artistic and administrative decision are all communal cultures. Many communal cultures operate outside settled lands, sticking to the wilds, a specific district in a larger settlement, city sewers, forgotten ruins, or other isolated places. For even when such cultures are harmless, their members know that outsiders might try to impose rules upon them if they live in the same place. As such, many folks in communal cultures focus on fending for themselves while avoiding the danger that other groups can represent.

Target Text: 平權
Source Text: Communal

Target Text: 組織型態決定了你社區的運作和領導方式。你可能來自有正式政府和法律的地方，或者你的文化可能比較不正式，領導者是自然產生的，沒有官方職位或誓言。
Source Text: Your culture’s organization aspect determines the functioning and leadership of your community. You might come from a place with an officially recognized government and a system of laws. Or your culture might have enjoyed a less-formal organization, with the people in charge having naturally gravitated toward their positions without any official offices or oaths.

Source Text: When you build a culture, select its organization aspect from the following options: bureaucratic or communal. You gain skill options from your chosen system of organization.

Target Text: 英雄的文化是他們在成長過程中的信仰、習俗、價值觀和生活方式。這些生活經驗決定了英雄在遊戲中的一些數據。就算英雄不認同自己文化的價值觀，這些價值觀仍然影響了他們的早期發展。有些人甚至是因為反抗自己的文化而成為英雄。
Source Text: A hero’s culture describes the beliefs, customs, values, and way of life held by the community in which they were raised. This community provides life experiences that give a character some of their game statistics. Even if a hero doesn’t share their culture’s values, those values shaped their early development and way of life. In fact, some people become heroes primarily from the rejection of the ways of their culture.

Target Text: 在遊戲中，英雄的文化指的是人群，而不是地點。你可能在元城長大，但你的文化比這更具體。例如，一名英雄的文化可能是元城的貴族「奧瓦羅家族」，也就是他成長的家族；另一名英雄的文化則可能是四處移動的團體或組織，例如海盜團，或立誓守護邪異魔法典籍的祕密巫師組織。思考你的文化時，具體一些會很有幫助，而文化的 4 個面向可以協助你做到這點：語言、生活環境、組織型態與成長經歷。
Source Text: For our purposes, a hero’s culture represents people, not a place. Yes, you might have grown up in the great city of Capital, but your culture is more specific than that. One hero’s culture might be House Alvaro, a noble house in Capital where they were raised. Another’s culture could be a group or organization that moves around, such as a band of pirates or a secret order of sorcerers sworn to protect books of fell magic. It helps to get specific when thinking about your culture, and working with the four aspects of a culture can help you do that: language, environment, organization, and upbringing.

Target Text: 你的英雄由那些收藏、研讀並分享書籍與其他紀錄的人們撫養長大。有些學者專精於特定領域，例如致力於魔法研究的法師學院，或是專門傳授某位神明教義的教會。在學術環境中成長的人，都懂得如何運用知識的力量。
Source Text: Your hero was raised by people who collect, study, and share books and other records. Some academics focus on one area of study, such as a college for wizards dedicated to the study of magic, or a church that teaches the word of one deity. People in an academic culture learn how to wield the power that is knowledge.

Target Text: 學術
Source Text: Academic

Target Text: 技能選項：從學識類技能中選擇 1 項技能（速選：歷史）。
Source Text: Skill Options: One skill from the lore skill group. (Quick Build: History.)

Target Text: 擁有創作成長經歷的英雄是在善於創作藝術或其他具有交易價值作品的群體中長大的。創作文化可能會創作出舞蹈、音樂、雕塑等精緻藝術，或製造馬車、武器、工具、建築等實用物品。在這樣的文化薰陶下，人們自然會培養出對精湛工藝和細節的重視。
Source Text: A hero with a creative upbringing was raised among folk who create art or other works valuable enough to trade. A creative culture might produce fine art such as dance, music, or sculpture, or more practical wares such as wagons, weapons, tools, or buildings. People in such cultures learn the value of quality crafting and attention to detail.

Target Text: 創作
Source Text: Creative

Target Text: 技能選項：從「音樂」、「表演」（交涉類技能）或工藝類技能中選擇 1 項技能（速選：表演）。
Source Text: Skill Options: The Music or Perform skill (from the interpersonal skill group), or one skill from the crafting group. (Quick Build: Perform.)

Target Text: 成長經歷是指你在文化中如何被撫養長大。這是英雄故事中更具體、更個人的部分。你可能被訓練成祕密巫師組織的新任大法師，或是持劍保護該祕法組織的護衛。也許你在山地王國學會深入礦坑尋找礦石，或是製造能比任何人單獨挖得更快、更深的機械。無論你的文化是什麼，你的成長經歷都會讓你在其中變得與眾不同。
Source Text: Your culture’s upbringing aspect is a more specific and personal part of your hero’s story, describing how you were raised within your culture. Were you trained to become the newest archmage in a secret order of wizards, or to be a sword-wielding bodyguard who protected that arcane organization? Did you learn to delve deep into mines looking for ore in a mountain kingdom, or did you build machines meant to dig faster and deeper than any person could alone? Whatever your culture, your upbringing makes you special within that culture.

Target Text: 你的英雄成長於一個靠勞動為生的文化中。勞動文化的人可能是耕作者，在農場裡種植作物或飼養牲畜；也可能是透過狩獵、設陷阱、伐木或採礦等方式採集自然資源的人；又或是在與聚落及貿易相關的勞力工作上表現出色，例如建築、運輸、裝卸貨物等。具有勞動成長經歷的人，深知辛勤工作的價值。
Source Text: Your hero came of age in a culture where people labored for a living. They might have been cultivators, typically raising crops or livestock on a farm. They might have harvested natural resources, whether by hunting, trapping, logging, or mining. Or they might have excelled at manual labor tied to settlement and trade, such as construction, carting, loading cargo, and so forth. People with a labor upbringing know the value of hard work.

Target Text: 勞動
Source Text: Labor

Target Text: 技能選項：從「鍛造」（工藝類技能）、「馴獸」（交涉類技能）或探索類技能中選擇 1 項技能（速選：舉重）。
Source Text: Skill Options: The Blacksmithing skill (from the crafting skill group), the Handle Animals skill (from the interpersonal group), or a skill from the exploration group. (Quick Build: Lift.)

Target Text: 你的英雄在一群從事被他人（無論在其文化內外）視為非法活動的人們中長大。海盜團、刺客公會或間諜組織都為金錢而進行非法行為。在暴政統治下，參與叛亂的人們也常被視為法外之徒。在這種文化中成長的人通常不介意為了私利而違反規則，而且還很擅長確保沒人發現自己的所作所為。
Source Text: Your hero grew up among folk who performed activities that other people—whether within or outside their culture—considered unlawful. A band of pirates, a guild of assassins, or an organization of spies all commit unlawful acts for money. And under tyranny, people engaged in rebellion are often considered lawless in their actions and activities. People brought up in a lawless culture typically don’t mind breaking the rules when it suits them—and are good at making sure no one finds out they did.

Target Text: 法外
Source Text: Lawless

Target Text: 技能選項：從諜報類技能中選擇 1 項技能（速選：潛行）。
Source Text: Skill Options: One skill from the intrigue skill group. (Quick Build: Sneak.)

Target Text: 擁有尚武成長經歷的英雄從小在戰士的薰陶下成長。這些戰士可能來自正規軍隊、傭兵團、專門獵殺怪物的冒險者公會，或其他生活圍繞著戰鬥的人們。擁有尚武成長經歷的英雄隨時準備迎戰，更重要的是，他們知道如何結束戰鬥。
Source Text: A hero with a martial upbringing was raised by warriors. These might have been the soldiers of an established army, a band of mercenaries, a guild of monster-slaying adventurers, or any other folk whose lives revolve around combat. Heroes with a martial upbringing are always ready for a fight—and they know how to finish that fight.

Target Text: 尚武
Source Text: Martial

Target Text: 技能選項：從以下技能中選擇 1 項：工藝類技能的「鍛造」或「製箭」；探索類技能的「攀爬」、「耐力」或「騎術」；交涉類技能的「威嚇」；諜報類技能的「警覺」或「追蹤」；或學識類技能的「怪物」或「戰略」（速選：威嚇）。
Source Text: Skill Options: One of the following: Blacksmithing or Fletching from the crafting skill group; Climb, Endurance, or Ride from the exploration group; Intimidate from the interpersonal group; Alertness or Track from the intrigue group; or Monsters or Strategy from the lore skill group (Quick Build: Intimidate.)

Target Text: 成長經歷
Source Text: Upbringing

Target Text: 你的英雄成長於那些統治他人並運用政治手段維持權力的領導者之中。許多家族世代皆為貴族，但在某些文化中，貴族頭銜是透過功績或聲望獲得的。無論如何，擁有這種背景的英雄都明白，對適當之人的耳語，有時比任何軍隊都更為強大。
Source Text: Your hero grew up among leaders who rule over others and play the games of politics to maintain power. Many families are nobles by birthright, but some cultures have noble titles earned through deeds or popularity. Whatever the case, heroes with this background understand why the whispered words in the right ear can sometimes be more powerful than any army.

Target Text: 貴族
Source Text: Noble

Target Text: 技能選項：從交涉類技能中選擇 1 項技能（速選：領導）。
Source Text: Skill Options: One skill from the interpersonal skill group. (Quick Build: Lead.)

Target Text: 從以下選項中選擇你「成長經歷」的面向：學術、創作、勞動、法外、尚武或貴族。你會根據所選的成長經歷獲得技能選項。
Source Text: Pick your upbringing aspect from the following list: academic, creative, labor, lawless, martial, or noble. You gain skill options from your chosen aspect.

Target Text: 導演可以使用本節規則建立文化，供玩家為角色選擇。玩家也可以運用這些規則為自己的角色建立獨特文化，或修改既有文化，並與導演合作，找出最適合這個文化存在於戰役世界中的位置。
Source Text: Directors can use the rules in this section to build cultures that players can choose for their characters. Players can use these rules to build a unique culture or modify an existing culture for their character, working with the Director to find the right place for that culture within the world of the campaign.

Target Text: 在很多世界中，至少有些文化主要由特定族裔組成。例如，在歐爾登的華斯洛里亞地區，貝德伽公國的居民大多是人類；而貝德伽北方的森林王國「大幻林」，居民主要是幻林精靈。不過，你仍然可以選擇來自這些文化，卻屬於不同的族裔。例如，在大幻林文化中長大的矮人會說伊林語，也可能很了解大自然；而在矮人領地「卡爾·卡拉瓦」文化中長大的矮人則會說札力語，也可能很熟悉鍛造技藝。
Source Text: In many worlds, at least some cultures have a majority ancestry. The people of Bedegar, a duchy in the region of Vasloria on Orden, are mostly humans. The folk dwelling in the Great Wode, a forest realm north of Bedegar, are primarily wode elves. However, you can always choose to be from one of these cultures and take a different ancestry. A dwarf raised in the culture of the Great Wode speaks Yllyric and probably knows a lot about nature, while a dwarf raised in the dwarf thanedom of Kal Kalavar speaks Zaliac and might know a good deal about smithing.

Target Text: 你可以一步一步地建立文化，或者使用下面的表格快速評估範例文化或建立自己的文化。如果你的英雄主要是與同族人一起長大，可以使用或修改「典型族裔文化」表格中的面向選項（還魂屍沒有列在這張表中，因為他們是在死後才獲得自己的族裔）。如果你想基於某種文化類型快速建立文化（例如貴族世家或海盜團），可以使用「文化範例」表格，然後添加符合該文化概念的語言。
Source Text: You can build your culture one aspect at a time, or you can use the following tables if you want to assess sample cultures or make your own culture quickly. To create an archetypical culture for a hero who grew up surrounded mostly by other members of their ancestry, use or modify the aspect options on the Typical Ancestry Cultures table. (Revenants are missing from this table because they don’t gain their ancestry until after they die.) If you’d rather quickly create a culture based on a cultural archetype, such as a noble house or a pirate crew, use the Archetypical Cultures table, then add a language that fits the culture’s concept.

Target Text: 使用文化
Source Text: Using Culture

Target Text: 為什麼要建立文化？
Source Text: Why Build a Culture?

Target Text: 創建角色不只是計算數據、選擇技能與招式，再把這些資訊記錄在角色表上。你是在創造英雄——故事中的主角，無論是一場單次冒險，還是一段英雄戰役。好好思考你所創造角色的性格和過往。這就是為什麼遊戲讓你建立文化，而不只是說：「選擇 3 項技能和 1 種額外語言。」我們希望玩家能將自己的英雄想像成複雜而細膩的角色。
Source Text: Building a character is about more than adding up your stats, picking skills and abilities, and recording that information on a character sheet. You’re building a hero—a main character in a story, be it a one-shot or a heroic campaign. Think about the personality and the past of who you are creating. That’s why the game lets you build a culture rather than simply saying, “Pick three skills and a bonus language.” We want players to imagine their heroes as complex and intricate characters.

Target Text: 凱利安帝國在三千年前統治了歐爾登八個地區中的五個。在這個人類帝國的鼎盛時期，所有人類（包括極北方華尼伽的居民，但不包括伊蘇群島的居民）都學會了凱利安語。對許多人來說，尤其是貴族和富人階層，凱利安語實際上取代了他們的母語。
Source Text: The Caelian Empire dominated five of the eight regions of Orden 3,000 years ago. During the height of this most recent human empire, all humans (including folks from Vanigar in the far north, but not folks from the islands of Ix) learned to speak the Caelian tongue. For many, especially the noble classes and the well-to-do, Caelian effectively replaced their native language.

Target Text: 凱利安帝國滅亡約一千三百年後，帝國各地區的語言正在復興。儘管如此，大多數地區的大多數人類仍多少會說凱利安語。
Source Text: Some 1,300 years after the fall of the Caelian Empire, the languages of the different regions of the empire are enjoying a resurgence. Still, the Caelian tongue is spoken by most humans in most regions to one extent or another.

Target Text: 由於凱利安帝國曾經如此強大，且勢力範圍極為廣闊，歐爾登大多數人都會說和聽懂一些凱利安語。任何與帝國有貿易往來、生活在帝國邊界附近，或受帝國影響的人，最終都學會了凱利安語，包括矮人、龍騎士、精靈、哈肯人、歐克、波德人、蜥蜴人和哥布林。在歐爾登，若有人會說多種語言，第二語言幾乎必定是凱利安語。所有玩家角色都懂凱利安語！正因如此，這種帝國語言如今被俗稱為「通用語」——也就是歐爾登大多數人共同使用的語言。
Source Text: Most people in Orden can speak and understand some Caelian, simply because the empire was so powerful and so widespread. Anyone trading with the empire or living near its borders or under its influence eventually learned to speak Caelian, including dwarves, dragon knights, elves, hakaan, orcs, polders, lizardfolk, and goblins. If a person speaks more than one language in Orden, the second language is almost always Caelian. All player characters know Caelian! As a result, that language of empire is now colloquially referred to as “the common tongue”—the language that most folk of Orden have in common.

Target Text: 凱利安帝國
Source Text: Caelian Empire

Target Text: 對於有志於創造偉大作品或揭開深層知識的英雄來說，能夠閱讀古代文字是極為重要的。許多珍貴的知識只存在於古代典籍和卷軸中，而這些文獻都是以現代文化不再使用的語言所書寫。
Source Text: For an adventuring hero with an ambition to create great works or unlock deep lore, being able to read ancient writing is most useful. Much deep lore is attested only in ancient tomes and scrolls written in languages that no modern culture uses.

Target Text: 這些古代文獻大多由預期會有其他人閱讀的人所寫。雖然這些知識可能藉由不與最初撰寫它們的學院或教派之外的人分享而保持神祕，但文字本身並非刻意設計成難以理解的形式。這些文獻不是用密碼撰寫，只是使用了人們早已不再使用的語言。
Source Text: Most of these ancient writings were written by people who expected other people to read it. The lore might have been kept secret by not sharing it with anyone outside the college or cult whose members originally wrote it, but the actual writing was not intended to be difficult to read or understand. It wasn’t written in code—just in a language that people stopped speaking long ago.

Target Text: 學者能先找出哪些現代語言源自這些古代語言，再將它們與同一時期可能留存至今的相關語言進行比較，從而重建許多已失傳的語言。這些古代語言的翻譯對工藝製作和學術研究都有極大的價值。
Source Text: Sages can reconstruct many of these languages by learning which modern languages descended from them, then comparing them to related languages from the same time period that might have survived. Translating such ancient languages has been extremely useful for crafting and research.

Target Text: 「絕跡語言」表格展示了歐爾登一些已消亡的語言，以及與這些古代語言相關的現代語言。

Target Text: 歐爾登的居民至少在三萬年前就開始口語交流、手語溝通和文字書寫，但世界上大多數古老語言如今已經消亡。許多已被徹底遺忘；有些語言來自未發展出文字系統的民族，因此無法被保存；另有許多語言雖留下文字記錄，卻沒有相關的後裔語言，導致現今沒有人知道這些文字實際代表的發音。
Source Text: Folk have been speaking, signing, and writing in Orden for at least thirty thousand years, but most of the world’s ancient languages are now dead. Many have been forgotten. Others were spoken by peoples who never developed writing, preventing those languages from being preserved. And many languages that were preserved in writing left no related descendants, so that no one now knows what sounds that writing represented.

Target Text: 「依族裔分類的語言」表格列出了歐爾登最常見、由大量人口積極用於口語和手語交流的語言。「華斯洛里亞人類語言」表格則顯示了該地區以人類為主之領土的主要語言。雖然大多數語言與特定族裔及文化相關，但成為某個族裔並不會自動讓你融入與該語言相關的文化。例如，如果你的歐克英雄在精靈文化中長大，你可能會說某種精靈語言，但可能從未學過卡力語。
Source Text: The languages on the Languages by Ancestry table are the most common languages actively spoken and signed by significant populations of people in Orden. The Vaslorian Human Languages table shows the dominant languages in that region’s human-centric territories. Most languages are associated with a specific ancestry and its culture, but being a member of an ancestry doesn’t automatically make you part of the associated culture the language is tied to. For example, if your orc hero was raised in a culture of elves, you probably speak one of the elf languages, and might never have learned Kalliak.

Target Text: 大多數語言都有通俗或日常的名稱。例如，在歐爾登，許多人會將卡力語稱為「歐克語」，將赫拉語稱為「精靈語」，但任何學者都明白，就如同人類擁有多種語言一樣，歐克和精靈也各自發展了許多語言。
Source Text: Most languages have colloquial or casual names. For instance, many people in Orden call Kalliak “Orcish” and Hyrallic “Elvish,” but any sage knows there are lots of orcish and elf languages, just as there are multiple human languages.

Target Text: 每種現存語言都有口語、手語和書面形式。若你學會一種語言，你就能夠說這種語言、使用該語言的手語，以及閱讀該語言的文字。
Source Text: Each extant language has a spoken, signed, and written version. When you learn a language, you know how to speak, sign, and read it.

Target Text: 赫拉語是歐爾登高等精靈的主要語言。雖然赫拉語在精靈語言中較為年輕，但仍然比幾乎所有其他現代文化語言還要古老（除了矮人的語言）。因此，雖然住在人類文化附近或與其貿易的人大多至少會說一點凱利安語，各族裔的大多數貴族仍會確保子女或後代學習赫拉語。從許多文化的觀點來看，凱利安語是新興語言，而赫拉語作為外交語言則被視為高雅且傳統的選擇。
Source Text: Hyrallic is the primary language of the high elves in Orden. Although young for an elf language, Hyrallic is older than almost all other modern cultural languages, save those of the dwarves. As a result, while anyone who lives near or trades with a human culture probably speaks at least a little Caelian, most nobles across all ancestries make sure their children or offspring speak Hyrallic. Caelian is new from many cultures’ point of view, while Hyrallic as a language for diplomacy is considered cultured and traditional.

Target Text: 伊林語是幻林精靈的文化語言，也是守護歐爾登自然森林之人的共同溝通方式。
Source Text: Yllyric is the cultural language of wode elves, and also the common language among those who defend and protect the natural forests of Orden.

Target Text: 在任何關於機械運作、石工或地質學的文件中，你很可能會發現大量札力語（最常見的矮人語）的專業術語。即使這些文本並非完全用札力語撰寫，但在描述深奧或複雜的概念時，人們仍廣泛採用矮人的語言。
Source Text: Within any document concerning the workings of machines, masonry, or geology, you are likely to find a healthy supply of jargon using Zaliac, the most popular dwarf language. Even when such texts aren’t fully written in Zaliac, they use a lot of dwarf language when describing esoteric, complex ideas.

Target Text: 正如札力語在工程領域廣泛應用，契約法也不完全以安賈利語寫成；安賈利語是地獄七城的主要語言。不過，許多契約中的法律術語，以及審判法庭中的部分用語，也大量採用安賈利語。地獄七城的居民極為重視細節，所以他們的語言在律師圈中備受推崇。
Source Text: Just as Zaliac is used in engineering, contract law isn’t written purely in Anjali, the dominant language of the Seven Cities of Hell. But a lot of the legal jargon in any contract, as well as some of the language of trial courts, features many Anjali words. People are sticklers for detail in the Seven Cities, and this makes their language popular among lawyers.

出血

若你處於出血狀態，每當你使用主要動作或反應動作，或使用力量或敏捷進行考驗或招式檢定時，在動作或檢定結算後，你會失去 1d6 + 等級的體力（無法以任何方式避免，每個動作只會失去 1 次體力）。

若你在自己的回合外使用主要動作，你也會受到此狀態的傷害。例如，若你在戰術家的【快出手】招式協助下使用免費反應動作發動招牌招式，你也會觸發出血狀態的傷害。
Source Text:
Bleeding

While a creature is bleeding, whenever they use a main action, use a triggered action, or make a test or ability roll using Might or Agility, they lose Stamina equal to 1d6 + their level after the main action, triggered action, or power roll is resolved. This Stamina loss can’t be prevented in any way, and only happens once per action.

You take damage from this condition when you use a main action off your turn. For example, a signature ability used as a free triggered action with the assistance of the tactician’s Strike Now ability triggers the damage from the bleeding condition.

Target Text:
暈眩

若你處於暈眩狀態，你在自己回合中只能執行其中 1 種動作：主要動作、機動動作，或移動動作。你也無法使用反應動作、免費反應動作，以及免費機動動作。
Source Text:
Dazed

A creature who is dazed can do only one thing on their turn: use a main action, use a maneuver, or use a move action. A dazed creature also can’t use triggered actions, free triggered actions, or free maneuvers.

Target Text:
畏縮

若你處於畏縮狀態，你對恐懼來源進行的任何招式檢定都會承受 1 個劣勢。若恐懼來源為生物，該來源對你進行的招式檢定會獲得 1 個優勢。你若知道恐懼來源的位置，你就無法主動接近該來源。若你已經因為某個來源而陷入畏縮，然後又從其他來源陷入畏縮，則新的畏縮狀態會取代舊的狀態。
Source Text:
Frightened

When a creature is frightened, any ability roll they make against the source of their fear takes a bane. If that source is a creature, their ability rolls made against the frightened creature gain an edge. A frightened creature can’t willingly move closer to the source of their fear if they know the location of that source. If a creature gains the frightened condition from one source while already frightened by a different source, the new condition replaces the old one.

Target Text:
擒制

若你被擒制，你的速度歸 0，而且只能被擒抱者（生物、物體或效果）強制移動。你無法使用擊退機動動作（詳見第 10 章〈戰鬥〉的「機動動作」），而且對擒抱者以外的目標進行的任何招式檢定都會承受 1 個劣勢。當擒抱者移動時，你會一起移動。若擒抱者的體型 ≦ 你，則擒抱者在擒抱期間的速度會減半。

擒抱者可以使用機動動作將你移動至相鄰的未占據空間。

擒抱者可以隨時釋放你來解除該狀態（無需動作）。你可以使用掙脫機動動作（詳見第 10 章〈戰鬥〉）來嘗試脫離。若你進行傳送，或你與擒抱者任一方被強制移動到雙方不相鄰的位置，擒制狀態就會立刻解除。

生物只能擒抱體型 ≦ 自己的生物。若生物的力量為 2 以上，則可以擒抱體型 ≦ 其力量的生物。

除非另有說明，生物同時只能擒抱 1 個生物。
Source Text:
Grabbed

A creature who is grabbed has speed 0, can’t be force moved except by a creature, object, or effect that has them grabbed, can’t use the Knockback maneuver (see Maneuvers in Chapter 10: Combat), and takes a bane on abilities that don’t target the creature, object, or effect that has them grabbed. If a creature is grabbed by another creature and that creature moves, they bring the grabbed creature with them. If a creature’s size is equal to or less than the size of a creature they have grabbed, their speed is halved while they have that creature grabbed.

A creature who has another creature grabbed can use a maneuver to move the grabbed creature into an unoccupied space adjacent to them.

A creature can release a creature they have grabbed at any time to end that condition (no action required). A grabbed creature can attempt to escape being grabbed using the Escape Grab maneuver (see Chapter 10: Combat). If a grabbed creature teleports, or if either the grabbed creature or the creature grabbing them is force moved so that both creatures are not adjacent to each other, that creature is no longer grabbed.

A creature can grab only creatures of their size or smaller. If a creature’s Might score is 2 or higher, they can grab any creature larger than them with a size equal to or less than their Might score.

Unless otherwise indicated, a creature can grab only one creature at a time.

Target Text:
狀態

有些招式與效果會對生物施加稱為「狀態」的特定負面效果。以下狀態會經常出現在遊戲中。當你的英雄受到這些狀態的影響時，請確實記錄在角色卡上。
Source Text:
Conditions

Some abilities and other effects apply specific negative effects called conditions to a creature. The following conditions show up regularly in the game and can be tracked on your character sheet when they affect your hero.

Target Text:
伏地

若你處於伏地狀態，你的身體會平貼地面。在此狀態下，你發動的任何打擊都會承受 1 個劣勢，而其他生物對你發動的近戰招式則會獲得 1 個優勢。你只能用爬行的方式移動，每移動 1 格都需要額外消耗 1 格移動力。你在伏地時無法進行攀爬、跳躍、游泳或飛行。若你在攀爬、飛行或跳躍時被擊倒伏地，則會立刻墜落。

除非造成伏地狀態的招式或效果另有說明，否則你可以使用起身機動動作（詳見第 10 章〈戰鬥〉的「機動動作」）來解除伏地。此外，若你願意，相鄰的生物也可以對你使用起身機動動作來將你拉起來。
Source Text:
Prone

While a creature is prone, they are flat on the ground, any strike they make takes a bane, and melee abilities used against them gain an edge. A prone creature must crawl to move along the ground, which costs 1 additional square of movement for every square crawled. A creature can’t climb, jump, swim, or fly while prone. If they are climbing, flying, or jumping when knocked prone, they fall.

Unless the ability or effect that imposed the prone condition says otherwise, a prone creature can stand up using the Stand Up maneuver (see Maneuvers in Chapter 10: Combat). A creature adjacent to a willing prone creature can likewise use the Stand Up maneuver to make that creature stand up.

Target Text:
束縛

若你被束縛，你的速度歸 0，無法使用起身機動動作，也無法被強制移動。你在進行招式檢定以及力量與敏捷考驗時會承受 1 個劣勢，而其他生物對你進行的招式檢定則會獲得 1 個優勢。

若你進行傳送，束縛狀態就會立刻解除。
Source Text:
Restrained

A creature who is restrained has speed 0, can’t use the Stand Up maneuver, and can’t be force moved. A restrained creature takes a bane on ability rolls and on Might and Agility tests, and abilities used against them gain an edge.

If a creature teleports while restrained, that condition ends.

Target Text:
緩速

若你被緩速，你的速度為 2（除非你的速度已經 < 2），而且無法進行遁移。
Source Text:
Slowed

A creature who is slowed has speed 2 unless their speed is already lower, and they can’t shift.

Target Text:
嘲諷

若你被嘲諷，只要你與嘲諷者之間保持效果線，你對嘲諷者以外的目標進行的任何招式檢定都會承受雙劣勢。若你已經被嘲諷，然後又受到其他來源的嘲諷，則新的嘲諷狀態會取代舊的狀態。
Source Text:
Taunted

A creature who is taunted has a double bane on ability rolls for any ability that doesn’t target the creature who taunted them, as long as they have line of effect to that creature. If a creature gains the taunted condition from one source while already taunted by a different source, the new condition replaces the old one.

Target Text:
虛弱

若你陷入虛弱狀態，你進行的任何檢定都會承受 1 個劣勢。
Source Text:
Weakened

A creature who is weakened takes a bane on power rolls.

Target Text:
運用技能

若你擁有適用於當前考驗的技能，該考驗會獲得 +2 加值。例如，若你的英雄擁有躲藏技能，你在所有涉及隱藏自己的考驗都會獲得 +2 加值，包括躲在桶子後方的敏捷考驗，或是混進人群的氣場考驗。

技能提供的 +2 加值與優勢不同，所以每次考驗可以同時獲得技能的 +2 加值，以及優勢提供的 +2 加值。

每次考驗最多只能套用 1 項技能。
Source Text:
Applying Skills

If you have a skill that applies to a test you make, you gain a +2 bonus to the test. For instance, if your hero has the Hide skill, you have a +2 bonus to any test you make that involves hiding yourself. This might include an Agility test to hide behind a barrel, or a Presence test to disappear into a crowd.

The +2 bonus gained for a skill isn’t an edge. A player can make a test that has both the +2 bonus for a skill and the +2 bonus for an edge.

You can’t apply more than one skill to a test.

Target Text:
混用屬性和技能

雖然某些技能經常與特定的屬性搭配使用，但只要合理，任何技能都可以套用於任何屬性的考驗。進行考驗需要用到什麼屬性，導演有最終裁定權，並可以根據實際情況要求你使用不同的屬性。

例如，若單純使用言語威脅他人，需要進行氣場考驗；但如果玩家描述英雄徒手將木頭撕成兩半來威嚇敵人，導演可能會改為要求進行力量考驗，而威嚇技能在這兩種考驗中都適用。同理，攀爬建築物通常需要進行力量考驗，但若英雄想在陽台間連續跳躍到達屋頂，導演可以改為要求進行敏捷考驗，而攀爬技能同樣適用於這兩種考驗。
Source Text:
Mixing Characteristics and Skills

Although certain skills are often paired with one characteristic more than others, a skill can apply to a test made using any characteristic that makes sense. The Director has the final say on which characteristic is used to complete a task, and can call for a different characteristic based on the circumstances.

For example, intimidating someone with a purely verbal threat is a Presence test. But if a player describes their character tearing a log in half with their bare hands to intimidate a foe, the Director is likely to call for a Might test instead. The Intimidate skill can apply to both tests. In the same way, scaling the side of a building is covered by a Might test, but if a hero does a series of leaps from one balcony to another to reach a roof, the Director could call for an Agility test instead. The Climb skill applies to both of these tests.

工藝類技能

工藝類技能主要用於製作和鑑定物品，以及組裝臨時裝置，在休整時特別實用。

Source Text:
Crafting Skills

Skills from the crafting skill group are used in the creation and appraisal of goods and for jury-rigging contraptions. They are especially useful during rests and downtime.

Rewards for tests made with crafting skills typically include having leftover rare material used in the creation process, knowing a buyer willing to pay extra for goods or items you’re appraising, or making a jury-rigged device so amazing that it lasts for more uses than it should.

Consequences for tests made with crafting skills typically include wasting rare materials used in the creation process, greatly overestimating or underestimating an item’s value, and poorly jury-rigging a contraption so that it harms people (or at least the wrong people).

Skill | Use
Alchemy | Make bombs and potions
Architecture | Create buildings and vehicles
Blacksmithing | Forge metal armor and weapons
Carpentry | Create items out of wood
Cooking | Create delicious dishes
Fletching | Make ranged weapons and ammunition
Forgery | Create false badges, documents, and other items
Jewelry | Create bracelets, crowns, rings, and other jewelry
Mechanics | Build machines and clockwork items
Tailoring | Craft clothing of cloth or leather

Target Text:
給導演：自訂技能

導演可以自由建立自己認為與戰役和冒險相關且實用的技能。例如，遊戲沒有用來釀造麥酒的釀造技能，也沒有用來創作藝術作品的繪畫技能，因為這些通常不是一款以對抗怪物、拯救世界為主題的遊戲會碰到的挑戰。不過，若導演覺得自己的戰役會涉及被下毒的麥酒桶、大量偽造藝術品，而且加入這些新技能會讓玩家玩得更開心，那就可以這麼做。

導演只需要替這些新技能選擇 1 個技能類別。在上述例子中，歸入工藝類技能很合理。接著告訴玩家，他們可以將自己擁有的任意 1 項工藝類技能換成其中 1 項新技能。
Source Text:
For the Director: Make Your Own Skills

Directors should feel free to make their own skills that they feel are relevant and useful to their campaigns and adventures. For instance, the game doesn’t have a Brewing skill for brewing ale or a Painting skill for making art because those aren’t tasks that typically come up in a game about fighting monsters and saving the world. However, a Director could decide that their campaign involves poisoned barrels of ale and large amounts of counterfeit art, and that adding these two new skills to the game would make it more fun for the players. The Director simply needs to pick a group for these new skills—in this case, crafting makes sense. They then let the players know that they can swap out any crafting skill they have for these new skills.

Target Text:
使用特定技能進行考驗的優勢

某些特性與招式會讓生物在使用特定技能的考驗中獲得優勢。即使生物本身沒有該技能，只要該技能適用於這次考驗，該考驗仍會獲得優勢。例如，神導士的【Blessing of Fortunate Weather】可以創造濃霧天氣，讓使用躲藏技能進行考驗的生物獲得優勢。所以，任何生物只要試圖躲藏在濃霧中，而且躲藏技能適用於該考驗，就能獲得優勢，無論該生物是否實際擁有該項技能。
Source Text:
Edges on Tests With Specific Skills

Certain features and abilities grant a creature an edge on tests made with a specific skill. A creature making a test where the specific skill would apply gains an edge on the test even if they don’t have the skill. For example, the conduit’s Blessing of Fortunate Weather can create foggy weather that grants creatures who make tests using the Hide skill an edge on those tests. Any creature who attempts to hide in the fog gains an edge on the test as long as the Hide skill would apply to that test, regardless of whether they have that skill or not.

Target Text:
所有技能都同樣實用嗎？

替角色選擇技能時，技能的實用度很大程度取決於戰役內容。例如，在英雄經常探索水下遺跡的戰役中，游泳技能可能會不斷派上用場，但如果整場戰役都發生在廣闊沙漠裡，游泳就不會那麼常出現。若某場戰役的主要敵人是心語者，靈能技能可能會經常派上用場；若英雄要對抗一群邪惡巫師，魔法技能可能更實用。若你擔心自己想選的技能派不上用場，你可以在創角後與導演討論你的技能清單。若某項技能實際玩起來不合適，你也可以按照自己的意願換成其他技能（詳見第 2 章〈創造英雄〉的「Changing Character Options」）。
Source Text:
Are All Skills Equal?

When choosing skills for your character, deciding which skills will be most useful depends a lot on the campaign. For instance, the Swim skill might be used constantly during a campaign that takes place on the ocean and has heroes exploring underwater ruins, but it won’t come up as much in a campaign that takes place entirely in a vast desert. The Psionics skill might come up a lot in a campaign where voiceless talkers are the main foes, and Magic might be more useful in a game where the heroes take on a circle of evil wizards. If you’re worried about whether a skill you’d like to take will be useful, discuss your skill list with the Director after you create a hero. And if a skill doesn’t work out, you can always trade it for another skill as you wish (see Changing Character Options in Chapter 2: Making a Hero).
